steps: Thanks to Ridge's efforts, the peas are thriving—but aren’t they getting a bit too big? Oh no, the pea shoots are going to eat us!
Hey, Boss! Over here, this way!
Look, these are the peas I planted before! They've already grown this much!
I've been carefully watching how they grow, and I've even been studying how the environment affects the yield. Thanks to you, Boss, the crossbreeding is going really well!
Looking around, I see Ridge's test plot is divided into sections, each growing a different kind of pea. Some are just tiny sprouts, while others are already tall.
I never expected that story about the "pea experiment" would end up being so fruitful...
And that's not even the best part! Recently, I started using some special nutrients to help them grow faster!
Depending on how you use these nutrients, you can get totally different results.==W== The peas have grown in all kinds of ways—you'll be surprised how much they vary!
And the most impressive one...==W== Hehe...
Boss, come with me and take a look~
W-whoa, it's humongous! Wait, can peas even grow this big? It's taller than a tree!
Pretty amazing, right? I used the latest growth booster developed by the research department on this one.
But this growth booster does have a downside. It makes the plant grow really fast in a short time, but it also reduces the number of pods...
Yeah, the stem is massive, but there's barely anything growing on it...
I've been working these past few days to figure out how to fix that! And today, I finally made an improved version of the growth booster!
That's why invited you here, Boss!
I'll use some right now and see how it works. Here we go—!
Ridge mixes the growth booster concentrate with a bunch of other mysterious stuff,==W== then pours it onto the soil beside the giant pea's roots...==W== Now we wait.
That's strange. Why isn't anything happening? It's supposed to work pretty quickly...
Maybe the dose wasn't enough...? I'll just add a bit more.
Even after Ridge adds more, the pea plant still doesn't react.
In that case, I'll just give it a little magical boost! Here goes—hey!
Is it really alright to use magic==W== for this?
It'll be fine, I do this all the time! No worries!
I hope so...==W== Wait, is that an earthquake?
Wh-what...?! The giant pea is ...==W== moving?!
Waaaah!==W== It huuurts!==W== H-How did this even happen?!==W== I can't believe this!
I'm happy it grew so big,==W== but... I never thought it would, like, move...
Are you okay? I'll save you!
Ah...==W== W-Wait...!==W== Not there...==W== N-No, don't pull like that!
If you pull like that,==W== it'll just get even more tangled up...==W== Ah,==W== w-wait!
Ngh... Ngh...==W== It's so tight...==W== I...==W== I'm not sure I can take this!
Sorry. I'm doing my best here...
Agh!==W== Wait, not there...!==W== Seriously!==W== Mister pea?==W== I'm gonna start getting angry==W== if you don't let me go!==W==
And you don't want that!==W== I'll cook you up==W== and eat you, okay?
Wow, I don't think I've ever seen you get angry!
Hm?==W== H-Hey...!==W== Ouch! OWWWW!==W== That hurts, that hurts!==W== Mister pea?==W== Wait...==W== Are you mad?
Hahaha...==W== So, uh,==W== I was just kidding about that whole eating you thing.==W== Are we good?
Eek!==W== N-No!==W== Ah!==W== I can't take...==W== Tap! I'm tapping out!
I have to help her—right now! But ...==W== how?!
Hey, you Shrubshrews over there! Listen to me—!
Ugh, they ran off so fast...==W== Tch, looks like I can't count on anyone else...==W== At least not monsters...!
Ugh— I can't hold it much longer—!
Damn it ... still not enough...==W== Guess I can't do this alone...?
Go get help? But there's no time...==W== With Ridge's dwindling stamina, every second counts—
Whoa...?! That's a lot of Shrubshrews! So they went to get help...?!
Led by the Shrubshrew chief we caught and let go earlier, the Shrubshrews leap at the vines wrapped around Ridge and start gnawing away.
In no time, the out-of-control giant pea is torn to shreds, and Ridge is finally free.
Amazing... Thank you so much, Shrubshrews!
They left right after helping us out... Maybe they really did come back to just repay the kindness you showed them before...
Yeah, maybe...==W== I guess now we're even...?
Let's not worry about that now...==W== Let's get back to the pea experiment, Boss!
More experiments? After everything we just went through, haven't you learned your lesson?!
Sure, things got a little ...==W== out of hand.==W== But it also gave me a lot of new ideas. I have to make the most of it!
It's always good to learn from your mistakes...==W== But are we really calling that just "a little out of hand?"
Besides, improving crop varieties is a big deal, it's something you have to tackle step by step! A setback like this isn't nearly enough to make me give up!
So—let's keep working hard to build up our food supplies! We've got this, Boss!
Uh, y-yeah...! That determination's definitely admirable, so ... good luck...==W== W-wait, am I a part of this, too?!
Yup! I can get a little reckless at times...==W== But with you around, I feel much safer!
Just "a little," huh...? Well, I guess I really can't leave you unsupervised...==W== All right, I'll drop by now and then to lend a hand.
Yay, that's awesome! Then, as a thank-you—
Look~! This whole cart of veggies—==W==it's all yours!
All ... all this...?! No way, this is way too much! I can't...!
Boss, you're my farmdie now! And farmdies always share the good stuff!
Whenever you feel like having some veggies, don't be shy, just drop by anytime!
I'll work hard to grow and save a portion of the produce for you, Boss!
Ridges waves her shovel and smiles brightly at me.
